summary: This broad set of DOM changes improves page reliability and performance, from reducing unnecessary attribute and text-processing work to fixing focus, fullscreen, screen-orientation, and page-navigation behavior. It also advances web features including WebTransport, Declarative Web Push, speculation-rules prefetching, CSS Typed OM, and image sizing, while tightening privacy and security checks around principals, content policy, and cookies. Several updates improve custom-element and scoped-registry handling, canvas resource cleanup, and page-load reporting; many are behind-the-scenes fixes with no visible change for most users.
